summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus borrowings for investment purposes) in Autism Impact Companies. The index is designed to measure the performance of publicly traded global companies in developed markets that provide products, services and/or research supporting the autism ecosystem comprised of individuals on the autism spectrum and within the broader neurodivergent community (“Autism Impact Companies”). It is non-diversified.
